message: The other day, as the wind howled outside and the skies turned that ominous shade of gray, I caught myself feeling a little smug. I had finally made sure our emergency kit was stocked—snacks, water, and even a flashlight that actually worked. My grandkids rolled their eyes when I insisted on packing a deck of cards, but let me tell you, nothing beats a friendly game of Go Fish when the power goes out! Have you ever felt like you were finally ahead of the game in your own little way?
